facts.text: Clear the evil out of the Barrow Mound for the Free Goblin Society.
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: Wayman changed the deal and the goblins agreed to settle only the upper mound instead

facts.text: A huge undead with a greatsword in the Barrow Mound stands in the way (see thread_4).
facts.ended_how: no longer relevant: the goal it blocked was replaced, and the goblins are walling off the stairs instead

facts.text: Wayman Tisdale promised Snurk the Walkout never to tell King Hogboon where the Free Goblin Society goblins are, who are now settled in the upper Barrow Mound.
